purpose: Discovery metadata for individual works before evidence approval; no source text or model context.

reuse_statuses.link_only: May point to source; no excerpt or model ingestion.
reuse_statuses.approved_excerpts: Rights reviewed and linked to public.approved_sources; only separately approved chunks may be used.
reuse_statuses.blocked: Do not ingest or reuse content under current terms.

approval_requirements: Real reviewer identity and review timestamp
Foreign key to independently approved public.approved_sources
security: Staging table has RLS enabled and no anon/authenticated access policies; service-role-only access.
notes: Catalog is distinct from the existing approved_sources and source_chunks evidence tables. A catalog status alone never authorizes question generation.
